locator.text: Display 37.5, p. 37, in the proof of Proposition 4.10

provenance.note: machine audit: worker, gate, reviewer; not confirmed by a human

verdicts.summary: Lean has an equivalent formula. Integrand, sign and parameters match exactly: realGradient = -L(w)H_*(w)/(H_*(w)^2+σ_*^2), so Λ * realPhase(η) = -Λ ∫_0^η L H_*/(H_*^2+σ_*^2) dw. Two rewritings. (i) The Lean writes the primitive in the dilated form η ∫_0^1 realGradient(tη) dt; the substitution w = tη turns it into ∫_0^η realGradient(w) dw, and the Lean independently proves d/dη realPhase = realGradient on its window with realPhase(0) = 0. (ii) realAmplitude carries an extra divisor C, so it is the paper's F(0,η) = ϕ(0,η)/C of (4.3)-(4.4) rather than ϕ(0,η) itself (the module docstring at NaturalAxisCoefficients.lean:544 calls it "the actual ϕ*/C"); multiplying by the fixed C > 0 recovers the display.
